method: Planning heuristic: same response length; generation time proportional to model parameter count relative to 0.6B; same setup time per model. No hardware speedup assumed.
limitations: Only 0.6B/L40S is measured. Larger models and RTX-PRO-6000 are unmeasured. Output lengths, GPU efficiency, larger batching, download/load time, and queueing can differ. These scenarios are not confidence bounds or a spending cap. CPU/RAM, storage and build charges are excluded.

measured_smoke.actual_device: NVIDIA L40S (confirmed via nvidia-smi on existing container)

metrics_recovery.reason: All 400 generations completed; post-generation distribution metadata lookup for injected modal raised PackageNotFoundError. Raw outputs were recovered from the automatically committed Volume; no generation was repeated.
metrics_recovery.output_tokens_per_second: Final remote progress log, rounded to 0.1 tokens/s; includes cold first-batch kernel compilation.
metrics_recovery.generation_seconds: Reconstructed approximately from exact output-token count divided by logged rounded throughput.
metrics_recovery.function_seconds: Approximate container start 2026-10-20 14:29:28-04:00 to completed generation/error 14:33:11-04:00; not an exact invocation duration or billing receipt.
metrics_recovery.setup_seconds: Approximate remainder of container interval after reconstructed generation time.
metrics_recovery.versions: Pinned image build logs and runtime startup logs; Modal runtime has no installed distribution metadata.
